statements.verbatim_passage: Conversations about the importance of the problem focused on the ways in which vulnerabilities to thermal extremes and thermal inequity are built into urban infrastructure, both indoors and outdoors.
statements.passage_as_proposed: Conversations about the importance of the problem focused on the ways in which vulnerabilities to thermal extremes and thermal inequity are built into urban infrastructure, both indoors and outdoors.
